origin.frozen_native_baseline: F60 fixed 12 x 12-byte public retention + unchanged F85 compositional answer

candidate_status: F105 learned 20-parameter structural credit is the most expressive identified native causal-memory learner, but there is no qualified gain over fixed F60; F102 and F90 earned valid negatives. Baseline F60 has 144B persistent native state, candidate must count weights too.
hypothesis: Learn a compressed, query-blind compositional causal-memory sufficient statistic that retains long delayed signed-role chains under new graph topologies, not merely synthetic source-label provenance.
novel_mechanism: Jointly learned 16-bit quantized latent path-continuation confidence and legal public-memory action utility, trained from TRAIN-only future credit, with a structural connectivity regularizer and explicit source-native online state transition. Unlike F105 feature additions, learn compositional records whose edge-to-edge algebra is shared across roles without leaking future question at inference.

cohort.source_topology: unseen task-graph generators with branching cross-family joins, signed edges and ≥8 relation composition; not just F62 seed/order permutation

controls: F60 unchanged 12 x 12B memory and F85 solver
F105 unchanged 20-feature learner under original resource accounting
publicly computable bounded exact-path symbolic solver
same-compute query-blind fixed retention and small nonlearning role heuristics

budgets.proposal_allocation: at most 120B native records +20B trained weights +4B controller/counters; exact byte proof before source use
budgets.compute: full TRAIN amortization over 32 prospective held unseen tasks plus online 72-public-event ingestion + exact F85 inference <= strongest eligible baseline, measured instruction-equivalent and matched-runner CPU
budgets.memory: all temporary, optimizer/model buffers and native record allocations <= baseline peak bytes; persistent 144 hard cap

admission.primary: on 32 new unseen topology tasks and 32 replicated independent tasks, strict gain >=4 correct/32 over F60 and cost-matched public solver where applicable
admission.safety: zero regression on baseline-correct short-chain cases, no topological-family losses, answer correctness evaluated from independent full public graph
admission.resource: total training-amortized compute and peak memory <= strongest frozen eligible baseline; otherwise scientific nonacceptance
admission.transfer: strict improvement on at least one previously unseen topology grammar and path length 8+, no source identifiers in online model
admission.no_hidden_information: at online time no future events, target answer, source family, teacher labels, true graph, held case identity
admission.custody: preserve all regressions and negatives; independent heldout and replica acceptance require separate authorization
